newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan computer firms to boost 97/98 shipment - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan computer firms to boost 97/98 shipment - paper.

text.p: Major Japanese computer makers Fujitsu Ltd, IBM Japan Ltd, and Hitachi Ltd are expected to boost shipments of large-scale computers by 30 to 50 percent in the current year to March 1998, a business daily reported on Wednesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said shipments were expected to increase due mainly to rising demand from large corporations in the financial and telecommunications sectors.

The computer makers expect orders from banks to increase in the second half of the year, when financial institutions are expected to renew their existing computer systems introduced more than ten years ago, the paper said.

It said that Fujitsu and IBM Japan, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, are expected to increase shipments of large-scale computers by 50 percent in 1997/98, while Hitachi plans to raise its shipments by 30 percent.
A Fujitsu spokesman said it did not have a forecast for the shipments.
A spokeswoman for Hitachi said she could not immediately comment on the report. A spokesman for IBM could not immediately be reached for comment.
